DOP: brahmañña brāhmañña mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) [ cf S. brahmaṇya], ( i ) belonging to brahmans, consisting of brahmans; D I 115, 31 (samaṇo … Gotamo … apāpapurekkhāro ~āya pajāya; Sv 286, 17 : brāhmaṇapajāya) = M II 167, 9 ; Ap 35, 1 (°-kulasambhūto, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee brāhmañña-; Ap-a 267, 34 : brāhmaṇakule sujāto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee brahmakule); — ( ii ) [ cf BHS brāhmaṇya], respectful, helpful, to brahmans; respectful to pure, excellent persons; D III 145, 27 (daḷhasamādāno ahosi … sāmaññatāya ~-tāya; Be, Ce, Se so; Ee brāhmaññatāya); S V 468, 5 (appakā te sattā ye ~ā … bahutarā sattā ye abrahmaññā; Spk III 303, 18 : brāhmaṇānaṃ hitā ~ā, tesu tesu sammāpaṭipannānaṃ yev’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); A I 142, 25 (kacci bahū manussā manussesu metteyyā petteyyā sāmaññā ~ā …); Dhp 332 (°-tā sukhā; Dhp-a IV 35, 4 foll.: bāhitapāpesu buddhapaccekabuddhasāvakesu sammāpaṭipatti yeva); Pv 19:19 (sāmaññā hotha ~ā evaṃ saggaṃ gamissatha; Pv-a 104, 13 : bāhitapāpapūjakā); — 2. ( n. ) [ cf S. brāhmaṇya], the state of a brahman; the state of a true brahman, a pure, moral person; excellent behaviour; Vin III 44, 23 (natthi imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ natthi imesaṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee brāhmaññaṃ; Sp 296, 21 : ~an ti seṭṭhabhāvo); D I 166, 1 (ime … tapopakkamā ekesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sāmaññasaṅkhātā ca °-saṅkhātā ca; Sv 354, 14 : brāhmaṇakammasaṅkhātā); 167, 19 (so ārakā va sāmaññā ārakā va ~ā); 168, 14 (dukkaraṃ bho Gotama sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ ~an ti; Sv 358, 3 foll.: idaṃ Kassapo mayaṃ pubbe ettakamattaṃ sāmaññaṃ ca ~an cā ti vicarāma, tumhe pana aññaṃ yeva sāmaññaṃ ca ~aṃ ca vadathā ti dīpento āha); II 248, 18 (pabbajjā bho appesakkhā ca appalābhā ca ~aṃ mahesakkhaṃ ca mahālābhaṃ cā ti); S III 50, 33 (na ca pana te … sāmaññatthaṃ vā °’-atthaṃ vā … upasampajja viharanti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se brāhmaññatthaṃ) = Paṭis II 4, 7 ( Be, Ce so; Ee brāhmaññattaṃ; Se brāhmaññatthaṃ); S V 26, 5 foll. (~aṃ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi °’-atthaṃ ca … ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo … idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ~aṃ; Spk III 132, 28 foll.: ~an ti seṭṭhabhāvaṃ, °’-atthan ti nibbānaṃ ~ena upagantabbato); Ja IV 303, 27* (panaṭṭhaṃ carasi ~aṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se brāhmaññaṃ); 362, 1* (apetā te ~ā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se brāhmaññā; 365, 26´ : brāhmaṇadhammato); Ap 51, 4 (~ā abhinikkhamma pabbajissati tāvade; Ap-a 301, 35 : brāhmaṇakulato nikkhamitvā, Be, Se so; Ce brahmakulato; Ee brahmaṇakulato); Mil 243, 25 (pabbajito ’mhī ti na sammā paṭipajjeyya atha kho so … ārakā va ~ā); Mp II 366, 16 (sāmaññatthena vā cattāro maggā °’-atthena cattāri phalāni); Ud-a 54, 28 (kevalaṃ jātimattakena ~aṃ paṭijānāti); Th-a II 265, 25 (brāhmaṇan ti vā ~aṃ āha, evaṃ uttamaṃ ~aṃ na jaccādīhi adhippāyo, Be so; Se na jaccādī ti; Ce, Ee brāhmaṇan ti brahmaññu āha; Ce na jaccādinā ti; Ee na jaccādī ti); — abrahmañña , mfn. , not respectful to brahmans; D III 70, 26 (amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā ~-tā); S V 468, 6 ; A I 138, 15 (~o; Mp II 228, 11 : ettha ca khīṇāsavā brāhmaṇā nāma, tesu micchā paṭipanno ~o nāma).
